title: Failure mode
description: evals/failure_modes/<name>.yaml. One named way the product goes wrong, found by reading traces. Failure modes are tags on the checks inside tasks.

name.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

definition.description: What counts as this failure, in plain words a judge and a new annotator can both apply. Say what Pass and Fail look like.

owner.description: The person or team who decides what counts.

examples.description: Trace ids that show the failure clearly. Used in the editor, not as few-shot examples; those live in the judge.

retired.description: Set when the mode is merged or no longer tracked. A retired mode cannot be referenced by a new check.

merged_into.description: When retired by a merge, the surviving mode.
